subject: GetYourGuide products that include Cambridge, read for what they actually include
source: data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json (destinations.Cambridge, London departures) plus the Cambridge location page l439 for products sold in Cambridge itself
method: Each product opened in the browser at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t{id}. Inclusions and exclusions read from the product page's own lists; from-price and price unit read from the page's booking bar and the product:price:amount meta tag. Twelve pages read.
theTest: Does the includes list name a college or attraction entry without an 'if option selected' clause? A title is not evidence.

doorPriceBaseline.Scudamore's self-hire punt: GBP 28.50 per punt for one hour, up to 6 people
